title: God Gets Us
verse: Stay awake and pray that you will not fall into temptation. The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak.
observation: God gets us. He sees their hearts. He sees they want to be faithful, but they are struggling. A bad king would say they are useless and helpless. Our King said, "I get it."
application: Where do I need to accept God's mercy?
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for Your mercy.
